owned_invariants: Rendered output never contains a control character from input other than newline.

score.level_basis: Crate root: re-exports and the terminal rendering of reports and explanations, with control-character escaping of all echoed input.

basis.G1: Header declares AuthorityEffect: None; the contract URN is unique; the public items are the ones the module docs and the crate README describe. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond this contract.
basis.G2: Non-Numeric profile: rendering is tested by exact-output and property tests (escaping, wrapping at 78 columns, colours only when asked).
basis.G3: Typed failures: every I/O or input problem becomes a `pfp: ...` message and exit code 2; no unwrap or expect in runtime code (clippy -D warnings); inputs are capped (10 MiB, 20,000 JSON values) and only regular files are opened. Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: 52 unit and end-to-end tests (safety contract, hostile inputs, path escapes, malformed JSON, escaping) pass; clippy -D warnings, rustfmt and the wasm32 build pass. Mutation R = 29/30 (see mutation_accounting).
basis.G5: Cyclomatic complexity from lizard; nesting from the brace estimate; cognitive complexity is not measured for Rust, so A is not claimed. Metrics: worst function: cyclomatic 9, cognitive None, nesting 1; metrics ceiling A+.
